description: This file defines the HeadersMetadataStrategy class, which implements MetadataStrategyInterface for handling metadata headers in AWS S3 encryption workflows. It includes methods for saving metadata into an envelope and loading metadata from an array of arguments.

classes.name: HeadersMetadataStrategy
classes.description: Implements MetadataStrategyInterface to manage reading and writing S3 object metadata headers related to encryption.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Stores metadata from a MetadataEnvelope into the array of arguments for the PutObject request, adding each header to the Metadata key.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Constructs a MetadataEnvelope object from the provided arguments, extracting relevant metadata headers.
